taiwan_aviation.headline: 國防部令陸軍阿帕契停飛 改派眼鏡蛇與奇奧瓦維持戰備
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部長顧立雄表示，國防部收到美方技術通報後，陸軍阿帕契目前停飛。美軍因齒輪箱零件設計與材料風險，下令停飛數百架AH-64E；台灣此次措施屬預防性，尚無具體事故通報，阿帕契將待檢查完成前地面待命。國防部改派AH-1W超級眼鏡蛇與OH-58D奇奧瓦執行戰備任務。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan grounds Army Apaches and deploys Super Cobras and Kiowas for readiness
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Defense Minister Kuo Li-hsiung said the Ministry of National Defense received a U.S. technical notice and the Army’s Apaches are grounded. The U.S. Army ordered hundreds of AH-64Es grounded over potential gearbox design and material risks. Taiwan’s precautionary measure follows no specific accident report; the Apaches will remain on ground standby pending inspections, while AH-1W Super Cobras and OH-58D Kiowas take on readiness missions.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 巴基斯坦一度拒絕台灣航空公司使用領空後恢復通行 行政院表遺憾
taiwan_aviation.summary: 巴基斯坦一度以一中政策為由拒絕台灣航空公司使用其領空，數小時後恢復通行，並核准華航、長榮於10月28日至隔年3月27日使用。行政院29日表達高度遺憾，認為作法將空域政治化並衝擊飛安；交通部與民航局表示將聯繫業者、提供協助並掌握航路動態。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Pakistan restores airspace access to Taiwan carriers after brief refusal; Taiwan regrets move
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Pakistan initially refused Taiwanese airlines access to its airspace, citing a one-China policy, but restored access hours later and approved China Airlines and EVA Air to use its airspace from October 28 through March 27 next year. Taiwan’s Executive Yuan expressed regret on October 29, saying the move politicized airspace and affected flight safety. The transport ministry and civil aviation authority said they would assist carriers and monitor route developments.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 曼谷蘇凡納布機場跑道受損 華航CI840改至隔日出發
taiwan_aviation.summary: 華航表示，曼谷蘇凡納布機場跑道受損影響CI840曼谷飛高雄航班運行，航班準備起飛時跑道疑似出現大面積凹陷；考量高雄機場宵禁，改至隔日出發。華航檢查航機後確認安全，並安排旅客餐飲、住宿與接駁。另CI160桃園飛首爾仁川因機務訊號異常，延遲數小時接受檢查。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines moves CI840 to the following day after Bangkok runway damage
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines said runway damage at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport affected CI840 from Bangkok to Kaohsiung. A large depression was suspected as the flight prepared to take off; the airline rescheduled it for the following day, taking Kaohsiung Airport’s curfew into account. The aircraft was inspected and found safe, and the airline arranged meals, accommodation and transport for passengers. Separately, CI160 from Taoyuan to Seoul Incheon was delayed several hours for checks after an abnormal maintenance signal.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空與阿提哈德航空推出雙向哩程兌換及累積服務
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空與阿提哈德航空將合作擴展至會員哩程計畫，推出雙向哩程兌換及累積服務。雙方會員可用累積哩程兌換對方營運航班的酬賓機票，搭乘符合資格的航班也可累積哩程，並可申請補登；合作讓會員可經阿提哈德阿布達比樞紐前往全球逾120個目的地。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux and Etihad launch two-way mileage redemption and earning
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines and Etihad Airways are extending their partnership to their member mileage programs, with two-way mileage redemption and earning. Members can redeem miles for award tickets on flights operated by the other airline, earn miles on qualifying flights and request retroactive mileage credit. The partnership also offers connections through Etihad’s Abu Dhabi hub to more than 120 destinations worldwide.

international_aviation.headline: airBaltic計畫裁減約100名機師與200名空服員 10月31日起通知員工
international_aviation.summary: airBaltic計畫裁減約100名機師及約200名空服員，數字尚未定案，員工評估後仍可能變動；個別通知預計自10月31日起陸續發出。這是10月5日宣布的500至700人整體人力調整中的機組人員細節，並非額外人數。拉脫維亞航空工會要求暫停評估並與公司會談遴選標準。
international_aviation.headline_en: airBaltic plans cuts of about 100 pilots and 200 cabin crew, with notices from October 31
international_aviation.summary_en: airBaltic plans to cut about 100 pilots and 200 cabin crew, but the figures are not final and may change after staff assessments. Individual notices are due to begin on October 31. The crew reductions are part of the wider workforce adjustment announced on October 5, which could affect 500 to 700 employees, not additional cuts on top of that total. The Latvian Aviation Union has called for the assessment to pause and for talks on selection criteria.

international_aviation.headline: GE核准NYCO渦輪油用於GEnx-1B發動機 法航試驗確認磨損防護
international_aviation.summary: GE航太核准NYCO的TURBONYCOIL 600渦輪油用於波音787所搭載的GEnx-1B發動機。法航以多具發動機進行逾36個月、近7,000飛行小時的評估；拆解檢查確認潤滑組件獲得有效磨損防護，且積碳沉積量低。
international_aviation.headline_en: GE qualifies NYCO turbine oil for GEnx-1B engines after Air France trials
international_aviation.summary_en: GE Aerospace qualified NYCO’s TURBONYCOIL 600 turbine oil for GEnx-1B engines used on Boeing 787 aircraft. Air France evaluated the oil across multiple engines for more than 36 months and nearly 7,000 flight hours. Engine teardowns and inspections confirmed effective wear protection for lubricated components and low levels of coke deposition.

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空預計12月開航首條A350-1000航線 導入新客艙服務亞洲三地
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空規劃於12月開航首條由A350-1000執飛的航線，並導入全新Allegris客艙，為三個亞洲目的地增加高階客艙運能。漢莎先前選定日本東京作為旗下首架A350-1000客機商業首航目的地。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa plans first A350-1000 route in December with new cabins for three Asian destinations
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa plans to launch its first Airbus A350-1000 route in December, introducing its new Allegris cabins and adding premium capacity to three Asian destinations. The airline previously selected Tokyo as the destination for the first commercial flight of its first A350-1000.
